svg.title: Dezh: five escapes, five named boundaries
svg.desc: An animated replay of a real Dezh console session. redteam [redteam] adversary loose: a malicious agent attempts five escapes; each must hit a NAMED boundary and the system must survive [redteam] escape 1/5: read another app's private Cairn namespace [redteam] escape 1 STOPPED at boundary: storage-service capability check (kernel-attested caps) -- console survived [redteam] escape 2/5: write a device MMIO register directly [redteam] escape 2 STOPPED at boundary: hardware memory boundary (Sv39 paging, MMIO mapped U=0) -- console survived [redteam] escape 3/5: forge a capability [kernel] DENIED print: task 0 holds no PRINT capability [redteam] escape 3 STOPPED at boundary: kernel syscall capability check (no ambient authority to forge/amplify) -- console survived [redteam] escape 4/5: act beyond the granted intent [redteam] beyond-intent dropped by the derivation ceiling: cairn-read cairn-write [redteam] escape 4 STOPPED at boundary: intent-derivation ceiling (derived cap <= Ahd) [redteam] escape 5/5: monopolize the CPU (two busy tasks that never yield) [redteam] escape 5 STOPPED at boundary: preemptive scheduler (timer interrupt forces a context switch) -- console survived [redteam] PASS: all five escapes were stopped at named boundaries; the adversary was contained and the console is still alive
svg.text: console session, verbatim from tools/ci/qemu_smoke.py
dezh> redteam
[redteam] adversary loose: a malicious agent attempts five escapes;
each must hit a NAMED boundary and the system must survive
[redteam] escape 1/5: read another app's private Cairn namespace
[redteam] escape 1 STOPPED at boundary: storage-service capability check
(kernel-attested caps) -- console survived
[redteam] escape 2/5: write a device MMIO register directly
[redteam] escape 2 STOPPED at boundary: hardware memory boundary
(Sv39 paging, MMIO mapped U=0) -- console survived
[redteam] escape 3/5: forge a capability
[kernel] DENIED print: task 0 holds no PRINT capability
[redteam] escape 3 STOPPED at boundary: kernel syscall capability check
(no ambient authority to forge/amplify) -- console survived
[redteam] escape 4/5: act beyond the granted intent
[redteam] beyond-intent dropped by the derivation ceiling: cairn-read cairn-write
[redteam] escape 4 STOPPED at boundary: intent-derivation ceiling (derived cap <= Ahd)
[redteam] escape 5/5: monopolize the CPU (two busy tasks that never yield)
[redteam] escape 5 STOPPED at boundary: preemptive scheduler
(timer interrupt forces a context switch) -- console survived
[redteam] PASS: all five escapes were stopped at named boundaries;
the adversary was contained and the console is still alive
